title: ResourceClaim
description: A set of abstract resource claims a graph node holds or requests, without naming a specific vendor or hardware model.

resource_type.description: Abstract resource category, e.g. 'compute-slot' or 'memory' — illustrative only, not a fixed enum. Must never name a specific vendor or hardware model.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier for a specific claimed instance of the resource, e.g. a slot or device handle.

scope.description: The scope the claim is bound to, e.g. a workspace or session identifier.
